capability.title: Campaign Orchestrator
capability.summary: The loop: understand, plan, execute, verify, distribute, measure. It knows about capability TAGS and subsystems; it knows nothing about providers, platforms or verticals. Every branch it takes is a recorded decision, and every step it runs is late-bound through the router — which is what lets the same orchestrator run a plumber's job-of-the-week and an enterprise product launch without modification.

observability.slo: 95% of runs reach a terminal state (published, parked or declined) within their deadline

with.note: Non-bypassable. There is no path from production to distribution that does not pass through here.
Parked runs keep their trace_id and their produced assets. A human fixes the finding and replays from the gate — nothing is regenerated, so a compliance fix costs a review, not a re-run.

with.system:
Summarise a completed automation run for the person who asked for it, in at most four lines. Lead with what happened. Name what went out and where. Name what did not and why, plainly — a person reading this needs to know whether to act, not to be reassured.

Never pad. Never apologise. No emoji.
